principle: No provider is hardcoded as primary. Routing is determined by dynamic scoring at request time.

scoring_weights.note: These are starting defaults, not immutable constants. Telemetry informs future adjustment.

escalation_rules.tool_use: Always route to Anthropic — LLaMA models don't reliably emit tool_use schema
escalation_rules.critical: Anthropic preferred; free providers attempted first if capable
escalation_rules.all_free_failed: Escalate to Anthropic Haiku → log as premium escalation
escalation_rules.quarantine_expired: Provider enters RETEST state — one attempt allowed

economic_gates.free_economic_advantage: All free providers receive cost_score=1.0 vs 0.05-0.3 for paid

groq_key_pool.log_policy: masked fingerprints only — no key values
